recommendations.reason: The Edelman methodology requires a minimum 3–6 month emergency buffer before allocating to growth assets. Without it, you risk liquidating long-term investments at a loss during income disruptions.

recommendations.alert_message: Retirement readiness is 0%. At your current contribution rate, you may face a significant retirement income gap.
recommendations.reason: Compounding is most powerful in the early years. A delay of 5 years in retirement savings can reduce terminal wealth by more than 30%, per Edelman's compounding analysis.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Each percentage point increase in savings rate today significantly reduces the retirement gap through compounding.
recommendations.action: Maximize employer 401(k) match first (free money), then contribute to a Roth IRA up to the annual limit. Review your retirement goal in the Goals section.

recommendations.alert_message: Your disability coverage is 0% of income. The Edelman recommendation is at least 60% of gross income protected.
recommendations.reason: A 30-year-old has a greater probability of suffering a disability before retirement than of dying. Your income is your greatest financial asset.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Adequate disability coverage protects your entire financial plan from collapsing if you cannot work.
recommendations.action: Review your employer group disability policy. If coverage is below 60% of income, request a supplemental individual disability policy quote.

recommendations.alert_message: Your life insurance coverage appears below the recommended 10–12× annual income level.
recommendations.reason: Edelman recommends sufficient life coverage to replace your income for 10+ years and pay off all debts, protecting your dependents.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Adequate life coverage ensures dependents maintain their lifestyle and financial goals without interruption.
recommendations.action: Obtain term life insurance quotes. For most households, a 20-year level term policy provides optimal coverage at the lowest cost.

recommendations.alert_message: Your estate plan is missing: Will, Durable Power of Attorney.
recommendations.reason: Without these documents, your assets cannot be distributed per your wishes and your family may face costly probate. Edelman considers estate documents as foundational financial hygiene.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Ensures your wishes are legally documented and avoids costly, time-consuming probate proceedings.
recommendations.action: Consult an estate attorney or use a reputable online legal service to draft the missing documents. Typical cost: $300–$1,500.
